name: open
description: Open files, apps, or URLs using default application

options.name: -a
options.description: Specify the application to use for opening the file

options.name: -b
options.description: Specify the bundle identifier of the app to use to open the file

options.name: -D
options.description: Reveals the enclosing folder in finder

options.name: -e
options.description: Opens the file with /Applications/TextEdit

options.name: -t
options.description: Open the file with the default text editor

options.name: -f
options.description: Read input from standard input and open the results in the default text editor

options.name: -F
options.description: Opens the application without restoring windows

options.name: --fresh
options.description: Opens the application without restoring windows

options.name: -W
options.description: Waits until the applications exit

options.name: --wait-apps
options.description: Waits until the applications exit

options.name: -R
options.description: Reveals the file(s) in the Finder instead of opening them

options.name: --reveal
options.description: Reveals the file(s) in the Finder instead of opening them

options.name: -n
options.description: Open a new instance of the application(s) even if one is already running

options.name: --new
options.description: Open a new instance of the application(s) even if one is already running

options.name: -j
options.description: Launches the app hidden

options.name: --hide
options.description: Launches the app hidden

options.name: -g
options.description: Do not bring the application to the foreground

options.name: --background
options.description: Do not bring the application to the foreground

options.name: -h
options.description: Searches header locations for a header whose name matches the given string and then opens it

options.name: --header
options.description: Searches header locations for a header whose name matches the given string and then opens it

options.name: -s
options.description: For -h, the SDK to use; if supplied, only SDKs whose names contain the argument value are searched

options.name: -u
options.description: Open this URL, even if it matches exactly a filepath

options.name: --url
options.description: Open this URL, even if it matches exactly a filepath

options.name: -i
options.description: Launches the application with stdin connected to PATH; defaults to /dev/null

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Launches the application with stdin connected to PATH; defaults to /dev/null

options.name: -o
options.description: Launches the application with /dev/stdout connected to PATH

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Launches the application with /dev/stdout connected to PATH

options.name: --stderr
options.description: Launches the application with /dev/stderr connected to PATH

options.name: --env
options.description: Add an enviroment variable to the launched process, where VAR is formatted AAA=foo

options.name: --args
options.description: All remaining arguments are passed to the opened application in the argv parameter to main().  These arguments are not opened or interpreted by the open tool
